reasons: Cited paragraphs (p0035 liaison/General Manager, p0061 no-joint-venture, p0068 survival, p0069 entire agreement) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant, so the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer') is satisfied on the face of the record.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct outcome for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the originals, confirming no unintended edits.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month cap, general-solicitation carve-out) are correctly explained as artifacts of clause absence — inserting such language would create a new restriction on our own client, contrary to the playbook.

Rationale properly scopes out Section 6 exclusivity/non-compete as governed by a separate rule and records the fallback position for use if the counterparty later proposes a non-solicit, preserving useful negotiation evidence.
